LanguageData.LP_SubduingCudgel.label: subduing cudgel
LanguageData.LP_SubduingCudgel.description: A leather-wrapped short club whose iron bands are engraved with drowsy slumber runes. Made specifically for knocking people out; however hard it hits, it only leaves them dizzy and finally unconscious.\n\nNonlethal: only knocks the target unconscious, causing no wounds and never killing. Good for taking prisoners.
LanguageData.LP_SubduingCudgel.tools.0.label: head
LanguageData.LP_SubduingCudgel.tools.1.label: poke
LanguageData.LP_NetCrossbow.label: net crossbow
LanguageData.LP_NetCrossbow.description: A heavy wooden crossbow with a coil of grey rope net on the stock. The binding net it fires makes the target stagger (stunned 2.5 seconds), then moving -50% for 6 seconds.\n\nNonlethal: only knocks the target unconscious, causing no wounds and never killing. Good for taking prisoners.
LanguageData.LP_NetCrossbow.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.LP_NetCrossbow.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: net crossbow
LanguageData.LP_Proj_Net.label: binding net
LanguageData.LP_SleepBow.label: slumber shortbow
LanguageData.LP_SleepBow.description: A dark green shortbow with lavender-dyed fletching, its arrowheads dipped in glowing purple slumber powder. Those hit only get sleepier and sleepier. Strong-minded races such as elves are less affected according to their mind resistance.\n\nNonlethal: only knocks the target unconscious, causing no wounds and never killing. Good for taking prisoners.
LanguageData.LP_SleepBow.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.LP_SleepBow.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: slumber shortbow
LanguageData.LP_Proj_SleepArrow.label: slumber arrow
LanguageData.LP_SleepStaff.label: slumber staff
LanguageData.LP_SleepStaff.description: A curved grey-white wooden staff whose crescent head holds a pale purple crystal, firing sleep-inducing slumber bolts. Its power varies with the wielder's psychic sensitivity (magic factor = sensitivity, minimum 0.2, no cap); in the hands of someone with zero sensitivity, the staff doesn't respond at all. Those with a psylink gain neural heat with each cast; those without a psylink only get 70% of the power. Strong-minded races such as elves are less affected according to their mind resistance.\n\nNonlethal: only knocks the target unconscious, causing no wounds and never killing. Good for taking prisoners.
LanguageData.LP_SleepStaff.tools.0.label: staff
LanguageData.LP_Bolt_Sleep.label: slumber bolt
